whole_lifecycle_findings.observation: Actual item binding admits OBSIDIAN/BEDROCK, empty block above and no entity in the 1x2 box. Server creates EndCrystal with bottom hidden, ignores addFreshEntity boolean, emits ENTITY_PLACE and requests current end fight tryRespawn. Item stack shrink and sidedSuccess follow; outer creative handling/payment receipts were not expanded. Item success is not proof of actual crystal or ritual admission.

tryRespawn requires dragonKilled and no current stage, finds/creates portal, and queries four horizontal boxes two blocks from portal.above1. Each box must contain at least one EndCrystal; all returned lists are added, so not exactly four participants and no fresh same-item payment test. respawnDragon replaces matched portal blocks, sets START/time0, spawns inactive portal and stores the provided crystal list. contains later uses Entity.equals integer entity id, not UUID membership, object-reference-only identity or continuous geometric quorum.

hurt first uses native isInvulnerableTo (removed, invulnerable flag with BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY/creative-player exceptions, fire/fall type predicates), then rejects causing EnderDragon. Own amount is not tested. Other own unremoved server path removes KILLED, requests strength6 block explosion only if incoming source lacks IS_EXPLOSION, then invokes fight callback and returns true; live client path can return true without server mutation. Already removed calls are rejected by inherited gate, not reported as true. This is source-level direct-call behavior, not a natural zero-damage attack result or all outer event admission.

kill directly invokes generic-source destroy callback before super.kill and has no own hurt/removed/invulnerability guard; base kill removes and emits ENTITY_DIE. Final inherited discard removes DISCARDED without a direct EndCrystal destroy callback. Repeated explicit kill calls are not proven idempotent; normal death entry assumptions, engine callbacks and exception outcomes are unexpanded. hurt may call explosion before its own callback; do not treat current stage as an immutable captured lease across external calls.

Callback while stage nonnull AND respawnCrystals.contains(crystal) clears stage, resets time0, resets current spike-column crystals and requests active exit portal. It does not explicitly null the stored list, clear beam on every surviving participant, delete all created crystals, refund item cost or restore previous terrain. reset scans ALL currently found EndCrystals in each spike AABB, not just a tracked spawned UUID list. TopBoundingBox spans DimensionType.MIN_Y..MAX_Y with spike XZ radius. No guaranteed all-world cleanup or rollback.
